Direct checks suited to the accessible material follow at suspected locations and appropriate reference areas. sections.title: Open and treat the material supported by the checks

Reachable water is collected; approved unsuitable covering or insulation is removed to expose retained material for cleaning and drying. The opening follows the needed material access rather than the outline of a colored image alone.

If a temperature anomaly has no supported moisture finding, the remaining question is recorded for the appropriate building or mechanical provider. Additional investigation can be needed, but an unexplained cool patch is not automatically converted into a demolition area.

sections.title: Verify drying without making a changed image the endpoint
paragraphs: Repeat material observations guide equipment adjustment and closure. A temperature pattern may disappear as room conditions change while a concealed layer remains wet. Conversely, a persistent surface difference does not justify indefinite drying if suitable direct checks and the identified assembly explain it.

The handoff states the material checked, access achieved and unresolved covered areas. Source repair and replacement-floor or wall requirements remain separate from both the thermal survey and the retained-material drying result.
